The arms, fists, legs and feet stay dark chocolate, and the gold foil and the cream bow stay as they are. Keep every shape, the pose, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: Bead pulp_wars-jdb.10, part 2: both egg samples drew a brown face with white eyes and a grin inside a foil hood, which can be misread as a caricature of a person; a white chocolate egg keeps the idea without it.
